title: 'Tokenmaxxing is not what we are optimizing for': Microsoft tells engineer to calm down on AI usage
excerpt: Microsoft forced to introduce new limits on AI token usage
content_html:
• Microsoft aims to cut down on "tokenmaxxing" by employees
  • New guidelines will look to control AI token use to focus on ROI
  • This is despite Microsoft reporting record financial results recently

Microsoft has apparently been forced to introduce limits on how much AI usage its engineers are allowed followed reports that some have been taking things to extreme.

The software giant is looking to cut back on "tokenmaxxing" within the company - where employees use far more AI tokens that may be necessary.

In an email seen by 404 Media, Microsoft warned employees that new limits on token usage would be introduced as it looked to focus on getting the most out of its AI platforms.

New guidelines

“As we accelerate our use of GitHub Copilot to deliver on our goals, we all need to be aware of how we consume tokens,” the email to employees from Jay Parikh, an executive vice president at Microsoft said.

“Tokenmaxxing is not what we are optimizing for," he continued. "I want all of us focused on maximizing outcomes that move the needle for our customers and our business.”

“As such, we are updating our internal guidance and managing token spend with the same discipline we apply to every other critical resource."

In a bid to achieve “get greater value from our token investment”, Parikh went on to say Microsoft is making access to the cheaper OpenAI GPT-5.6 model the default model for internal use.

Employees were also reminded (via a link to updated internal Copilot guidelines) that as of July 2026 Microsoft divisions have an “AI token budget target,” with employees also able to track their individual AI spending.

“While there is no target spend value being shared at this time. The data shows that many engineers spend in the range of hundreds of dollars a month to a few thousand dollars in tokens,” 404 Media reported the guidelines as saying.

Parikh noted that Microsoft does not want to impair the company’s progress towards becoming “AI-first,” and that it will keep learning and adjusting its AI policies as models and products evolve.

“We are not optimizing for fewer tokens,” he said. “We are optimizing for more impact per token."

The restrictions may come as a surprise to some Microsoft employees, given that the company recently reported yet another bumper financial quarter, and in that respect should have money to splash out on AI usage.

However it is the latest step by Microsoft as it looks to focus internal AI usage. In May 2026, it was reported the company was reportedly canceling most of the Claude Code license it uses internally, with engineers being told to use GitHub Copilot CLI, with users given a June 30 2026 deadline to remove Claude Code from their workflows.

However tokenmaxxing has proven to be an issue at other tech giants - perhaps most notoriously at Uber, which was forced to admit it had exhausted its entire annual 2026 AI coding token budget in just four months due to massive employee adoption of agentic tools like Anthropic PBC's Claude Code and Cursor.

Amazon also recently revealed it had spent $1.8 million on an internal Claude Sonnet deployment intended for matching author details with product listings, after it ballooned far beyond its planned budget and was ultimately given menial tasks to do.

content_html_zh:
• 微软旨在减少员工的“tokenmaxking”行为
  • 新的指导方针将着眼于控制人工智能代币的使用，以关注投资回报率
  • 尽管微软最近公布了创纪录的财务业绩

微软显然被迫对其工程师的人工智能使用量进行限制，因为有报道称有些工程师已经把事情变得极端了。

这家软件巨头正在寻求削减公司内部的“tokenmaxxing”——员工使用更多可能必要的人工智能代币。

在 404 Media 看到的一封电子邮件中，微软警告员工，将引入新的代币使用限制，因为它希望专注于充分利用其人工智能平台。

新指南

微软执行副总裁 Jay Parikh 在发给员工的电子邮件中表示：“当我们加速使用 GitHub Copilot 来实现我们的目标时，我们都需要了解如何使用代币。”

“Tokenmaxxing 并不是我们优化的目的，”他继续说道。 “我希望我们所有人都专注于最大化结果，为我们的客户和我们的业务带来推动。”

“因此，我们正在更新我们的内部指南，并按照我们应用于所有其他关键资源的相同原则来管理代币支出。”

为了实现“从我们的代币投资中获得更大价值”，Parikh 继续表示，微软正在将更便宜的 OpenAI GPT-5.6 模型作为内部使用的默认模型。

还提醒员工（通过更新的内部 Copilot 指南的链接），截至 2026 年 7 月，微软各部门都有一个“人工智能代币预算目标”，员工还可以跟踪他们的个人人工智能支出。

“虽然目前没有共享目标支出值。 数据显示，许多工程师每月花费数百美元到数千美元的代币，”404 Media 报道指南称。

帕里克指出，微软不想损害公司迈向“人工智能优先”的进程，并将随着模型和产品的发展不断学习和调整其人工智能政策。

“我们不会针对更少的代币进行优化，”他说。 “我们正在优化每个代币的影响力。”

这些限制可能会让一些微软员工感到惊讶，因为该公司最近报告了又一个丰收的财务季度，从这方面来说，应该有钱花在人工智能的使用上。

然而，这是微软的最新举措，因为它希望专注于内部人工智能的使用。 据报道，2026 年 5 月，该公司取消了其内部使用的大部分 Claude Code 许可证，工程师被告知使用 GitHub Copilot CLI，用户必须在 2026 年 6 月 30 日的最后期限前从其工作流程中删除 Claude Code。

然而，tokenmaxxing 已被证明是其他科技巨头的一个问题——也许最臭名昭著的是 Uber，由于员工大量采用 Anthropic PBC 的 Claude Code 和 Cursor 等代理工具，该公司被迫承认在短短四个月内就耗尽了 2026 年人工智能编码代币的全部预算。

亚马逊最近还透露，它已花费 180 万美元用于内部 Claude Sonnet 部署，旨在将作者详细信息与产品列表进行匹配，此前该项目的预算远远超出了计划预算，并最终被分配了一些琐碎的任务。
